text: I'm really sorry to bother you at this hour. I'm a foster carer and I've had a little boy with me for a few weeks, he's 10 months. He's got a temperature of 38.9 tonight and I've got both calpol and ibuprofen in the cupboard but I've gone completely blank on how much he can have, and I'm terrified of getting it wrong because he's not mine. Can I give him one of them now and how much for his age? Is it ok to use both or just stick to one? His nappies are still properly wet, changed a heavy one about an hour ago, so I don't think he's drying out or anything. Sorry, I know this is probably a really basic question
